floorPlans.introduction: Compare the one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts published by Nshama.
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. The printed totals for 2 BR Type B and 3 BR Type A can differ from rounded suite and balcony sums by 0.01 sq ft. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 5 Nshama design renders and 4 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. Selected photographs depict the structure under construction.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 4 and 9. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3003 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 4 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The printed totals for 2 BR Type B and 3 BR Type A can differ from rounded suite and balcony sums by 0.01 sq ft.
